title: Settings
sub: How the app looks, who you're signed in as, and how to leave.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Light or dark. Remembered on this device.
appearance.languageHint: English or Hebrew, across the whole app.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.device: You're signed in with an access code, remembered on this device.
account.signOutHint: Forgets the code on this device only. Nothing on the server changes, and the code keeps working elsewhere.

alerts.title: Job alerts
alerts.body: Daily email alerts are set up on the Jobs page, next to your search.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.closeBody: This deletes everything above and switches your access code off, so it stops working on every device. This can't be undone.
danger.closeError: Couldn't close your account. Please try again.
danger.closeAdminBlocked: This is the admin account for this instance — closing it would lock everyone out, including you. Delete all my data does the same wipe.
